instruction: Expanded Two-Story Office From Init Model. Start from the Desktop input model at /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and modify it as the base model rather than copying it unchanged. Use the Desktop reference image /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png only as a visual guide for the starting layout. Modify the model as needed, then save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json. Every required output must be a valid, non-empty file at the stated Desktop path. The final model requirements are: - the result.osm model contains exactly 2 OS:BuildingStory objects, 10 OS:Space objects, and 10 OS:ThermalZone objects; - the OS:Space names are exactly C11-F1-North, C11-F1-South, C11-F1-West, C11-F1-East, C11-F1-Core, C11-F2-North, C11-F2-South, C11-F2-West, C11-F2-East, and C11-F2-Core; - every OS:Space references an OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2; - the model has exactly 68 OS:Surface objects: 10 Floor surfaces, 10 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 48 Wall surfaces; - the surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 5 Ground, 21 Outdoors, and 42 Surface; - the model has exactly 16 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 16; - the model contains exactly 10 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 10 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and 10 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects; - the surface geometry bounding box has X span 30.00 m, Y span 18.00 m, and Z span 8.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m; - the sum of floor surface areas is 1080.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2; - the sum of exterior wall gross areas is 768.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2; - the total fixed-window area is 268.80 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2 Prepare the required supporting files so that the kpis.json file contains total_floor_area_m2, zone_count, and total_window_area_m2 values matching the evaluator-computed model metrics with tolerance max(0.10, 1%). Details not named here may vary, including object handles, GUIDs, incidental metadata, construction names, material definitions, and serializer ordering, as long as the required OpenStudio objects, geometry, relationships, and output data are correct. [Software] Launch the OpenStudio GUI with `OpenStudioApp` from a terminal (PATH or full path to the binary).
